scope.objective: Locate common visible road, footpath and kerb defects in permitted street-level imagery and return reviewable evidence with provenance and uncertainty.
excluded: Engineering-grade depth, crack-width or structural-capacity measurement
Automated inference from ordinary Google Maps or Street View content
Satellite-based pothole, crack or detailed footpath detection
Automatic transfer of observations into a TWM project
Safety-critical or maintenance decisions without human review

surfaces.label: Footpath
surfaces.definition: A visible pedestrian walking surface beside or separated from the carriageway.

surfaces.label: Kerb
surfaces.definition: The visible raised or flush boundary between carriageway, drainage edge and footpath.

defects.label: Pothole
defects.definition: A visible bowl-shaped or irregular loss of carriageway material.

defects.label: Longitudinal crack
defects.definition: A visible crack running mainly along the direction of travel or path alignment.

defects.label: Transverse crack
defects.definition: A visible crack running mainly across the direction of travel or path alignment.

defects.label: Alligator cracking
defects.definition: An interconnected visible crack pattern resembling small blocks or scales.

defects.label: Uneven or broken footpath
defects.definition: A visibly displaced, missing, fractured or substantially uneven pedestrian surface.

defects.label: Broken kerb
defects.definition: A visibly cracked, displaced or missing kerb section.

defects.label: Standing water
defects.definition: Visible ponded water obscuring or occupying an infrastructure surface.

defects.label: Debris or vegetation obstruction
defects.definition: Visible debris or vegetation materially obstructing the usable surface.

uncertainty_policy.production_threshold_status: Depends on the separately evaluated model package.
uncertainty_policy.rule: Every automated observation must report confidence, uncertainty state and human review state. Confidence alone must not be presented as engineering certainty.

source_policies.label: Licence-audited public dataset
source_policies.role: Candidate input after a dataset-level licence, privacy, attribution and geographic-leakage audit.
requirements: Train, validation and test split provenance recorded

source_policies.label: Institution-owned or authorised imagery
source_policies.role: Preferred validation and deployment evidence when written authority, privacy controls and retention rules are recorded.

source_policies.label: KartaView street imagery
source_policies.role: CC BY-SA 4.0 candidate source. A frozen dataset manifest, attribution, privacy review and share-alike analysis are required before AI use.

source_policies.label: Google Maps and Street View
source_policies.role: Interactive map and human-review source only under the ordinary Maps JavaScript and Street View services used by this prototype.
requirements: Do not scrape, bulk download, cache or index imagery
Use provider content only within the permissions in the linked service terms
Retain Google attribution and in-product terms

source_policies.label: Copernicus Sentinel
source_policies.role: Free, full and open satellite context for the separate Satellite Hazard Context function. Its resolution is not a Function 1 street-defect input.
requirements: Use the Sentinel legal notice and attribution
Keep satellite hazard analysis separate from detailed street defects

source_policies.label: Individual user upload
source_policies.role: Optional research evidence only. It is not the future ordinary-user primary workflow and cannot enter training by default.

source_policies.label: Unknown or unverified source
source_policies.role: Rejected until provenance, rights, privacy and permitted uses are documented.
requirements: Complete a source audit before any use

future_user_workflow: Map displays evidence, provenance and confidence
Human reviews the result with available street-level imagery

acceptance_checks.label: Google or other unapproved AI source is rejected

reasons: Depth cannot be inferred from a single uncalibrated image

legal_note: This technical source gate is not legal advice. Re-audit the exact dataset terms, privacy basis and deployment agreement before accepting training assets, training a model or enabling automated inference.
